definitions.explanation: Woven or felted material used for making clothes or other items.

examples.english: I wiped the desk with a cloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{布|ぬの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかくて→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: This fabric is very soft and feels nice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布|ぬの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I bought fabric in a color I liked and made curtains myself.

notes:
{布|ぬの} is a general term for cloth or fabric material.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {布|ぬの}を{縫|ぬ}う: to sew cloth
- {布|ぬの}を{切|き}る: to cut cloth
- {布|ぬの}で{拭|ふ}く: to wipe with a cloth
- {布|ぬの}{地|じ}: fabric, textile

COMPOUNDS:
- {布団|ふとん}: futon (bedding)
- {雑巾|ぞうきん}: cleaning rag
- {布巾|ふきん}: dish cloth
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket

TYPES OF FABRIC:
- {綿|めん}/{木綿|もめん}: cotton
- {絹|きぬ}: silk
- {麻|あさ}: linen
- ウール: wool
